description: Client-side script for the 'Job Card' doctype in ERPNext, managing form setup, actions, timers, and related operations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the 'Job Card' form, including queries, indicators, and button visibility.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, updates flags, buttons, and fetches related data based on current document state.

methods.name: setup_quality_inspection
methods.description: Configures route options for quality inspection related to the job card.

methods.name: setup_corrective_job_card
methods.description: Adds a button to create a corrective job card linked to the current one.

methods.name: make_corrective_job_card
methods.description: Calls server method to create a corrective job card and navigates to it.

methods.name: operation
methods.description: Handles changes to the operation field, fetching operation details and updating related fields.

methods.name: operation_row_number
methods.description: Sets the operation ID based on selected operation row number.

methods.name: toggle_operation_number
methods.description: Shows or hides the operation row number field based on current operation data.

methods.name: prepare_timer_buttons
methods.description: Sets up start, pause, resume, and complete buttons for job timing.

methods.name: start_job
methods.description: Starts the job timer and logs the start time.

methods.name: complete_job
methods.description: Completes the job timer and logs the end time and completed quantity.

methods.name: make_time_log
methods.description: Creates a time log entry and updates sub-operations.

methods.name: update_sub_operation
methods.description: Updates the current sub-operation based on ongoing logs.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form data before save, resets timer if needed.

methods.name: reset_timer
methods.description: Resets the start time field.

methods.name: make_dashboard
methods.description: Creates a stopwatch dashboard for job timing.

methods.name: hide_timer
methods.description: Removes the stopwatch display.

methods.name: for_quantity
methods.description: Fetches required items based on quantity.

methods.name: make_material_request
methods.description: Creates a material request document.

methods.name: make_stock_entry
methods.description: Creates a stock entry document.

methods.name: timer
methods.description: Returns a start button HTML (placeholder).

methods.name: set_total_completed_qty
methods.description: Calculates and updates total completed quantity from time logs.
